C-STATIC-LANGUAGE-EXPORT.IntentSummary: Implement the user's explicit complete static-language export request at the existing portable exporter; generate portal/published only on demand.

T-001.Title: Add static packaging and native content adapters

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Separate full EN/RU packages expose source content without scripting, retain file links and local fonts, and replace only owned output.

T-002.Title: Generate and check the requested published editions

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Every page resolves, scripting is absent, actual hidden content remains readable, both standalone editions work on desktop and mobile under file URLs.

T-003.Title: Document regeneration and reconcile exporter ownership

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Document the explicit static export command and separate entry files, reconcile existing GRACE module/verification/deployment context, apply/archive after fresh checks, commit source only and report the generated package paths.
